<!-- Página inicial inspirada em bedimcode/portfolio-responsive-complete,
     adaptada à paleta do site (azul #08519c, laranja #fd8d3c). -->
<style>
  .jv-home {
    --azul: #08519c; --azul-medio: #2171b5; --azul-suave: #e8f0f9;
    --laranja: #fd8d3c; --laranja-texto: #c4540d; --laranja-suave: #fff1e6;
    --tinta: #1f2933; --cinza: #5f6b7a; --linha: #e2e6ea;
    color: var(--tinta);
  }
  .jv-home a { text-decoration: none; }
  .jv-wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem; }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .jv-hero { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; align-items: center;
    gap: 2rem; min-height: calc(100vh - 62px); padding: 3rem 0 4rem; }
  .jv-hero__eyebrow { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--laranja-texto); margin: 0 0 1rem; }
  .jv-hero__title { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5.2vw, 3.8rem); line-height: 1.12; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--tinta); margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }
  .jv-hero__title::after { display: none !important; }
  .jv-hero__title span { color: var(--azul); }
  .jv-hero__role { font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem); color: var(--cinza); max-width: 34rem; margin: 0 0 2.2rem; }
  .jv-buttons { display: flex; gap: .8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .jv-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .75rem 1.6rem; border-radius: .5rem;
    font-weight: 600; border: 2px solid var(--azul); transition: box-shadow .3s, background .2s, color .2s; }
  .jv-btn--solid { background: var(--azul); color: #fff !important; }
  .jv-btn--solid:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(8, 81, 156, .25); }
  .jv-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--azul) !important; }
  .jv-btn--ghost:hover { background: var(--azul-suave); }
  .jv-social { display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
  .jv-social a { font-size: 1.45rem; color: var(--tinta); transition: color .2s, transform .2s; }
  .jv-social a:hover { color: var(--azul); transform: translateY(-2px); }

  .jv-hero__img { justify-self: center; width: min(440px, 100%); }
  .jv-hero__img svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; overflow: visible; }
  .jv-blob-back { fill: var(--laranja); opacity: .9; }
  .jv-blob-ring { fill: none; stroke: var(--azul); stroke-width: 3; opacity: .25; }

  /* ---------- SECTIONS ---------- */
  .jv-section { padding: 4.5rem 0 3.5rem; }
  .jv-section--tint { background: #f5f6f8; }
  .jv-section__title { text-align: center; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2rem); font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--azul); margin: 0 0 3rem; }
  .jv-section__title::after { content: ""; display: block; width: 64px; height: 3px; background: var(--laranja);
    margin: .7rem auto 0; }

  /* About */
  .jv-about { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center; }
  .jv-about__facts { display: grid; gap: .9rem; }
  .jv-fact { display: flex; gap: .9rem; align-items: center; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--linha);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: .9rem 1.1rem; }
  .jv-fact i { font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--azul); background: var(--azul-suave); border-radius: 50%;
    width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; }
  .jv-fact b { display: block; color: var(--tinta); }
  .jv-fact span { color: var(--cinza); font-size: .92rem; }
  .jv-about__subtitle { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tinta); margin: 0 0 1rem; }
  .jv-about__subtitle::after { display: none !important; }
  .jv-about p { color: #323f4b; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 1.4rem; }
  .jv-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; }
  .jv-chip { font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; padding: .35rem .85rem; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--laranja-suave); color: var(--laranja-texto); }

  /* Work cards */
  .jv-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .jv-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--linha);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; color: var(--tinta) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(31, 41, 51, .06); transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s; }
  .jv-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(8, 81, 156, .14); border-color: #c6dbef; }
  .jv-card i { font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--azul); }
  .jv-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tinta); margin: .2rem 0 0; }
  .jv-card p { font-size: .93rem; color: var(--cinza); margin: 0; line-height: 1.55; flex: 1; }
  .jv-card .jv-more { font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--azul-medio); }
  .jv-card:hover .jv-more { color: var(--laranja-texto); }

  /* Contact */
  .jv-contact { text-align: center; max-width: 40rem; margin: 0 auto; }
  .jv-contact p { color: var(--cinza); margin: 0 0 1.8rem; line-height: 1.7; }
  .jv-contact .jv-buttons { justify-content: center; }

  /* Footer */
  .jv-footer { background: var(--azul); color: #fff; text-align: center; padding: 2.2rem 1rem; }
  .jv-footer__name { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 1rem; }
  .jv-footer__social { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .jv-footer__social a { color: #fff; font-size: 1.3rem; opacity: .9; }
  .jv-footer__social a:hover { color: #c6dbef; opacity: 1; }
  .jv-footer__copy { font-size: .82rem; color: #c6dbef; margin: 0; }

  /* Reveal on scroll (desligado para quem prefere menos movimento) */
  .jv-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .jv-reveal.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .jv-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
    .jv-card, .jv-social a { transition: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .jv-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .jv-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: 0; padding: 2rem 0 3rem; text-align: left; }
    .jv-hero__img { order: -1; width: min(300px, 80%); }
    .jv-social { margin-top: 2rem; }
    .jv-about { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    .jv-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>

<script>
// Revela as seções ao rolar a página (como o ScrollReveal do modelo, sem biblioteca externa)
(function () {
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(".jv-reveal");
  if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) { els.forEach(function (e) { e.classList.add("is-visible"); }); return; }
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (en) { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("is-visible"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  els.forEach(function (e, i) { e.style.transitionDelay = (i % 3) * 90 + "ms"; io.observe(e); });
})();
</script>
